# Cinematic & Brand Storytelling (`cinematic-storytelling`)

Unified Antigravity plugin bundling narrative architecture, brand storytelling, silent-first web cinema, scroll-world direction, and classical animation/filmmaking staging.

## Included Skills

- **`silent-web-cinema`** — Master orchestrator for muted/sound-off 3D & web brand films: 1.5s visual + caption hook, Rail + Earned Climax subtitle choreography, metaphor-to-positioning bridge, camera sightline/occlusion audit, and silent visual urgency cues.
- **`brand-storytelling`** (`pedronauck/skills`) — Brand narrative principles (customer as hero / mentor positioning, five-second transformation beat, starting in action, repeatable analogies).
- **`storytelling`** (`ghaida/intent`) — Four canonical narrative structures (*Protagonist-arc*, *Choreography*, *Situation → Complication → Resolution*, *What-is / What-could-be*, plus *Kishōtenketsu*) and the five anti-slop refusals.
- **`filmmaker`** (`dylantarre/animation-principles`) — Disney's 12 principles adapted to camera direction, staging, secondary action, eyelines, and shot timing.
- **`scroll-world-storytelling`** (`mengto/skills`) — 5–7 beat ledger and art-direction bible for real-time Three.js worlds, scrubbed video, and story-led landing pages.
- **`cinematic-scroll-storytelling`** (`mengto/skills`) — Editorial GSAP + Lenis pacing, masked reveals, and restrained motion tokens.
- **`motion-and-storytelling`** (`dembrandt/dembrandt-skills`) — Subtlety-first UI and scene transitions driven by narrative intent.

## Cross-Plugin Coordination

Works alongside sibling plugins when active:
- `writing-and-agent-ops` → `copywriting`, `humanizer`
- `hyperframes-video-studio` → `captions-overlay`, `hyperframes-creative`
- `threejs-3d-gamedev` → `camera-systems`, `ghibli-environment-art`
- `frontend-ui-ux` → `impeccable`, `ux-psychology-laws`
- `web-motion-animation` → `choreograph`
